vectors.desc: Java shadowed-field collision: one name bound to two declaring classes rejected
deriv: the flattened list would carry 'x' twice — same name, distinct declaring classes, here with distinct types INT-8 and STRING: a loud error at descriptor build, never a silently resolved shadow (java.md 2.2 :243-244; 5.2 :548)
